description: Players over time, the way RoTerminal’s charts read them, for up to 8 lines at once: games, all of Roblox, a genre’s games, a trend word’s games. Detail follows the span: half-hour averages up to 2 days, hourly to 14 days, daily past that (a d column of days), then the count right now. Comes back as a dataset: a time column (t, or d for days) and one column per line. Free and Plus reach back 7 days; Pro and Studio every day since tracking began (Sep 27 2026). Each game counts toward the day’s games’ history.

before.description: With exactly one line: the stretch before too, laid on the same times

days.description: How far back, in days (default 7; Free and Plus see 7)

games.description: Games: names, universe ids or links

items.description: The game: its name (like "grow a garden"), its universe id, its Roblox link or place id, or its roterminal.co/g/ link

genres.description: Genre or subgenre names, like Tycoon or Simulation

hours.description: How far back, in hours (instead of days)

words.description: Trend words: the games whose names have it, like egg or brainrot
